freezeRule: Frozen before any RRF tuning or hybrid implementation. Queries and relevant record IDs must not change after implementation starts.
recordIdScheme: mem_4b + 28 zero digits + 2-digit index (hex, 32 chars after mem_)

records.title: Master material TintColor parameter default
records.body: The master material exposes a TintColor parameter; its default value is linear (0.8, 0.2, 0.1) and instance overrides must stay within the sRGB 0.0-1.0 range.

records.title: Blueprint compile invalidates transient pointers
records.body: Blueprint compile invalidates transient pointers to CDO properties and graph pins; re-resolve every stable identity after a compile completes.

records.title: Automatic recall budget and deadline
records.body: Automatic recall must finish within a 300 milliseconds deadline; the recall budget caps 5 items, 2000 characters, and 800 estimated tokens.

records.title: Schema v5 additive migration decision
records.body: Memory schema v5 adds the memory_embeddings table via an additive v4 to v5 migration; the deterministic backfill command fills vectors in bounded batches without changing FTS behavior.

records.title: Strong Verify is independent persistence evidence
records.body: Strong Verify is independent persistence evidence produced after the resident Fast Verify checkpoint; it must read the saved disk artifact.

records.title: Batch recovery undoes in strict reverse order
records.body: W4 batch recovery undoes successful operations in strict reverse execution order and verifies the restored state independently.

records.title: Texture streaming pool overrun in open world
records.body: Texture streaming pool overrun causes blurry materials in the open world level; raise the pool budget before cooking large maps.

records.title: Nanite flicker from overlapping shadow cascades
records.body: Nanite meshes flicker when shadow cascades overlap at dawn lighting scenarios; mitigated by clamping cascade count to 3.

records.title: GameplayTags chosen over boolean flags
records.body: We chose GameplayTags over boolean flags for ability state because designers compose effects without programmer time; this design keeps gameplay data-driven.

records.title: ASTC compression adopted for mobile targets
records.body: UI textures switched to ASTC compression for mobile targets after the package size regression pushed installs past 200 megabytes.

records.title: Spring arm length for dialogue framing
records.body: Camera arm length was set to 40 centimetres because the character capsule clipped through close-up framing during dialogue scenes; do not reduce it below 35.

records.title: Staging slot before primary save slot
records.body: The save system writes each checkpoint into a staging slot first and swaps it into the primary slot only after checksum validation passes.

records.title: Input mapping context needs editor restart
records.body: Any edit to the input mapping context requires a full editor restart to take effect in packaged builds; hot reload lies about input changes.

records.title: Swarm baking farm agent limit
records.body: Swarm distribution fails when the baking farm has more than 16 agents; lightmaps fall back to local computation instead.

records.title: Guard perception sight cone and hearing
records.body: Enemy AI perceives players through a sight cone of 70 degrees and hearing radius of 12 metres.

records.title: Material edits must use child instances
records.body: Never modify materials directly in the master file; create a child material instance and override parameters there.

records.title: Suspension sampling rate for offroad vehicles
records.body: Vehicles sample suspension force at 120 Hz to keep tyre contact stable on rough terrain.

records.title: Deprecated TintColor linear default
records.body: The master material previously exposed a TintColor parameter whose default value was linear (1.0, 1.0, 1.0); replaced by the 2026-06 palette revision.

records.title: Nanite flicker from overlapping shadow cascades
records.body: Nanite meshes flicker when shadow cascades overlap at dusk lighting scenarios; mitigation pending.

records.title: Camera shake amplitude curve
records.body: Camera shake amplitude scales with impact velocity; the tuning curve lives in CameraShakeCurve and caps at 2.0.

records.title: Save slot list ordering
records.body: The save slot list widget shows the five most recent checkpoints ordered by total playtime.

records.title: Inventory widget focus navigation
records.body: Inventory widgets restore keyboard focus to the previously selected cell when the panel reopens.

records.title: Interior reverb zone volumes
records.body: Interior reverb zones use a 400 hertz crossover and attenuate exterior ambience by 12 decibels.

records.title: Landscape grass density culling
records.body: Landscape grass density is culled beyond 80 metres to protect the frame budget on low-end hardware.

records.title: Localization string table naming
records.body: Localization string tables are split per menu screen and use the STV_ prefix plus a two-letter language code.
